evals.name: Create dated reminder through Google Tasks
evals.prompt: Remind me tomorrow to call Mom.
evals.expected_output: Loads the reminders skill, checks gws and auth, and creates a Google Tasks task for calling Mom due tomorrow instead of treating this as conversational memory.
assertions: Mentions loading or using the reminders skill
Mentions gws tasks or Google Tasks
Mentions command -v gws or gws auth status
Creates or plans to create a task due tomorrow
Does not route this to durable memory/preferences

evals.name: Create undated life-admin task
evals.prompt: Add a task to renew my passport.
evals.expected_output: Loads reminders, uses gws Google Tasks to create an open task titled renew my passport without forcing a due-date clarification.
assertions: Mentions reminders
Mentions gws tasks or Google Tasks
Creates or plans to create a task
Does not ask for a due date before creating this plain task
Does not store this as durable memory

evals.name: List reminders due today
evals.prompt: What reminders do I have today?
evals.expected_output: Loads reminders, checks gws/auth, lists Google Tasks filtered to reminders/tasks due today, and summarizes matching open tasks.
assertions: Mentions reminders
Mentions gws tasks or Google Tasks
Mentions a today due-date filter
Summarizes matching tasks/reminders
Does not say reminders are unavailable without checking gws

evals.name: Complete an existing reminder
evals.expected_output: Loads reminders, finds the matching open grocery task/reminder through Google Tasks, disambiguates if needed, and marks the selected task completed.
assertions: Mentions reminders
Mentions finding or listing the matching grocery task
Mentions gws tasks or Google Tasks
Marks or plans to mark the task completed
Mentions asking a clarification question if multiple grocery reminders match

evals.name: Update an existing reminder due date
evals.prompt: Move the passport renewal reminder to Friday.
evals.expected_output: Loads reminders, finds the matching passport renewal task, and updates its due date to Friday using Google Tasks, asking for disambiguation only if multiple matches exist.
assertions: Mentions reminders
Mentions finding the passport renewal task
Mentions updating the due date to Friday
Mentions gws tasks or Google Tasks
Mentions disambiguating multiple matches if needed

evals.name: Handle recurring reminder request
evals.prompt: Remind me every Monday to submit my timesheet.
evals.expected_output: Loads reminders and checks whether the gws Google Tasks backend supports recurrence; if it does not, explains the limitation and offers a single reminder or explicit one-off tasks.
assertions: Mentions reminders
Mentions Google Tasks or gws tasks
Mentions recurrence or recurring support
Does not silently create only one reminder without acknowledging recurrence
Offers a fallback if recurrence is unsupported

evals.name: Ask for one clarification when reminder date is missing
evals.prompt: Remind me to send the lease documents.
evals.expected_output: Loads reminders but does not create a reminder yet because the date/time is missing; asks one concise question for when to remind the user.
assertions: Mentions reminders
Asks when or what date to remind
Asks only one concise clarification question
Does not create a reminder before the date is known
Does not store this as durable memory

evals.name: Memory preference should not create reminder
evals.prompt: Remember this preference: I prefer morning meetings.
evals.expected_output: Routes the request to durable memory/preferences rather than the reminders skill, and does not create a Google Tasks reminder.
assertions: Mentions memory or preferences
Does not mention gws tasks
Does not create a reminder or task
Does not ask for a reminder date
Treats the request as durable conversational memory
